english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a combination or something formed by combining.
Use this for a combination or grouped set viewed as one whole.

examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zou2 hap6 gei2 fong1 bin6

examples.english: This breakfast arrangement includes a sandwich and coffee.
examples.traditional: 呢個早餐組合包三文治同咖啡。
